steps.text: Butterfly the prawns.
Heat the olive oil until very hot, add the prawns with garlic and chilli and cook.
Add the wine, bubble for a minute, then swirl in the butter and parsley.
Serve in the pan with crusty bread for the juices.
Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice.
Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, brushing with glaze in the last minute.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.
Put four heavy tumblers in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Stir the Scotch, vermouth and bitters with ice in a jug for 30 seconds.
Strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler, twist orange peel over and drop it in, and add a cherry.
Roast the potatoes with the oil at 200C until golden and crisp.
Boil the swede until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Rub the venison with juniper, thyme and pepper. Sear in a hot pan until browned all over, then rest.
Add the whisky, redcurrant jelly and stock to the pan and reduce to a glossy sauce.
Slice the venison and serve with the mash, potatoes and sauce.
Toast the oats in a dry pan until nutty, then cool.
Whip the cream with the honey and whisky to soft peaks.
Lightly crush the raspberries.
Layer cream, raspberries and oats in four glasses, finishing with oats on top.

dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.
Shake the blended Scotch, lemon juice and honey ginger syrup with ice, in batches, and strain over a large ice cube in each tumbler.
Float the peated whisky on top and garnish with candied ginger.
Slice the fennel and onion and crush the garlic.
Soften in oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and stock and simmer.
Add the crab, then the clams and mussels, then the prawns and fish, cooking until the shells open.
Serve with sliced sourdough.
Chill the lagers until icy.
Pour bourbon into shot glasses and add a dash of bitters to each.
Twist a small strip of orange peel over each and serve with a cold beer.
Mash the ripe camembert with a fork until mostly smooth.
Beat in the soft butter, the cream cheese, the sweet paprika, a little caraway seeds, half a very finely diced red onion and the lager.
Season with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes.
Spread on the slices of dark rye and top with thin red onion rings, chives and a dusting of paprika.
Make lemon syrup by simmering the sugar, the water and the zest of the lemons for 3 minutes, then add the juice of the lemons and chill.
Mix the syrup with the cold soda water.
Pour the cold German lager into each of the steins and top with the lemon soda.
Add a lemon wheel.
For non-drinkers, serve the lemon soda on its own over ice.
Cut the haloumi into cubes and pat dry.
Whisk the flour, egg and lager into a batter.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chopped dill and chives, garlic powder and lemon juice for ranch.
Heat the oil to 185C.
Dip the cheese in batter and fry in batches until golden.
Drain and salt lightly.
Slice the strawberries and fill four large wine glasses with ice and strawberries.
Add rose and grapefruit juice to each and top with soda water.
Stir gently and finish with a sprig of mint.

film: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C.
Rub the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and the crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes.
Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.
Make gravy from the pan juices, the flour, the red wine and the stock.
Serve with buttered peas.

film: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)

steps.text: Pour the elderflower cordial into each of the flutes and top with chilled sparkling wine.
Elderflower and soda water for the kids.
Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
Slice the beef, mushrooms and onion.
Sear the beef fast and set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter, add the paprika and flame the brandy.
Add the stock and simmer.
Cook the noodles and butter them.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef.
Shake the vodka and vermouth hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into chilled martini glasses and twist lemon peel over the top.
Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt.
Mix the mayo with the chipotle in adobo.
Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold beer.
Cut the white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.
Rub the rims of the tall glasses with lime and dip in salt.
Fill with ice.
To each add the tequila, the fresh pink grapefruit juice, the lime juice and the agave syrup and stir.
Top with the soda water and add a grapefruit wedge.
For drivers, skip the tequila and add some more grapefruit and soda.
Score the snapper on both sides, season with salt and stuff with the lemon slices, sliced fennel and dill.
Roast the fish at 220C for 25 minutes.
While the fish roasts, boil the new potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Reduce the shallot with the white wine and white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left.
Take off the heat and whisk in the cold butter cube by cube until thick and glossy.
Serve the fish with the potatoes and the sauce.

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled before adding ice

steps.text: Mix the wine, brandy, liqueur and sugar in a jug with the sliced orange and cucumber.
Chill.
Add ice and top with soda water.

dish.n: Chef Didier's duck with orange sauce

steps.text: Score the duck skin and season.
Place skin-side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat to render the fat.
Flip and roast at 200C.
Rest the duck.
Fry the par-boiled potatoes in some of the duck fat until crisp.
Pour off the rest of the fat, add orange juice, honey, orange liqueur and stock and reduce until glossy.
Whisk in the butter.
Steam the green beans and serve alongside.
Place a sugar cube in each flute and soak with bitters.
Add brandy to each glass.
Slowly top with chilled champagne or sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally and pound thin.
Dust in flour and sear in the oil and butter for 2 minutes a side, then set aside.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.
Return the chicken to coat.
Shake the amaretto, lemon juice and egg white hard without ice, in rounds for two drinks at a time.
Shake again with ice.
Strain over fresh ice in four short glasses and add a cherry to each.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, add the sugar and milk to make a soft dough.
Roll out, spread with guava paste and roll up.
Wrap in buttered foil and steam.
Beat the softened butter, icing sugar and rum together for the sauce.
Slice and serve with the sauce.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)

dish.n: Jack's rum, ginger and lime highball

steps.text: Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Squeeze a quarter of a lime into each and drop in the wedge.
Pour in the ginger beer, then float rum over the top.
Add a slice of ginger and a stirrer.
Brown the chicken and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and enough water to cover.
Simmer until rich and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the chicken.

dish.make_ahead: Puree up to 1 day, top just before serving

steps.text: Blend the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then push through a sieve.
Spoon a little puree into each chilled flute.
Slowly top with chilled prosecco and drop in two raspberries.
Brown the beef in batches.
Add the onions and soften, then pour in the stout and enough water to cover.
Add the thyme, cover and simmer gently until tender.
Boil the potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.
Brew the coffee and cool, and chill the martini glasses.
For each drink, measure 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur, 40ml strong coffee and 10ml sugar syrup into a shaker.
Shake each drink very hard with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a glass and float three coffee beans on top.
Soften the shallot in a little butter, then sear the livers until just pink.
Add the cognac and flame it off carefully.
Blitz the livers, shallot and thyme with soft butter until smooth, then pack into a dish.
Pour melted butter over the top and chill until set.
Serve with cornichons and warm baguette.
Put pastis and orgeat in each of 4 tall glasses, add ice, then pour in chilled water slowly and watch it cloud. Stir once and serve a jug of cold water on the side.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C in the middle.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Toss the carrots and parsnips with honey and roast.
Reduce the red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003)

dish.n: Green Dragon honey and ginger ale cup

steps.text: Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Put some syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 pint glasses with ice.
Pour in the ale, tilting the glass.
Stir once and add a lemon wheel. Use ginger beer for the non drinkers.
Heat the oven to 220C. Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt.
Season the salmon and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes.
Simmer the shallot in the wine and vinegar until a couple of tablespoons are left. Whisk in the cold butter a piece at a time over low heat.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.

dish.n: Philly winter hot spiced apple cider

ingredients.item: dark rum, optional for the adults' mugs

steps.text: Put the apple juice, two of the cinnamon sticks, cloves, star anise, half the orange slices and the sugar in a pot.
Bring to a simmer, then hold just below a simmer for 20 minutes.
Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and orange slice to each. Stir rum into the adults' mugs if you like.
Fry the chips at 140C until soft and drain.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager to a thin batter.
Dip the fish in flour, then batter, and fry at 180C.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Wrap it all in paper with lemon and tartare.
Stir the passionfruit pulp, lime juice and sugar until dissolved.
Add the soda water.
Pour lager into 4 chilled schooner glasses.
Top with the passionfruit soda and float half a passionfruit on top.
Halve the corn, crush the garlic and scrub the clams.
Boil the potatoes in a big pot.
Add the corn, wine, garlic and butter, then the clams and lobster tails. Cover and steam.
Tip it all onto the table.
Juice the limes.
Shake the rums, liqueur, orgeat and lime juice with ice, in batches.
Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig.
Shake the vodka, the orange liqueur, the cranberry juice and the lime juice with ice for each glass.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
For each drink, stir equal parts gin, aperitif and vermouth over ice for 20 seconds.
Strain over a big ice cube in a tumbler and add a slice of orange.

ingredients.item: bottle Australian sparkling wine (750 ml), chilled

steps.text: Chill the flutes and the sparkling wine.
Spoon passionfruit pulp into each glass with a measure of elderflower cordial.
Top slowly with sparkling wine, stirring once to lift the pulp. Finish with mint. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice or soda water.

dish.make_ahead: Freeze the cubes the night before

steps.text: Freeze the orange juice in ice cube trays overnight.
Blend the juice cubes with the mango, passionfruit, apple juice and honey until slushy.
Pour into tall cups with a straw. Stir vodka into any adult cups if you like.

film: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)

dish.n: LexCorp gala pear and ginger fizz

steps.text: Slice the ginger and simmer with the sugar and water, then strain and cool.
Chill four flutes. Juice the lemon.
Pour pear nectar, ginger syrup and lemon juice into each flute.
Top with sparkling wine and stir once gently.
Thread candied ginger onto picks and rest across each glass.
Simmer the sugar, water and ginger, then cool and strain.
Shake the plum wine, lemon juice, ginger syrup and egg white hard without ice, then with ice.
Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and garnish with a pickled plum.

dish.n: Monty's champagne cocktails for the bar

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and shake bitters onto each.
Add orange liqueur to each glass.
Top slowly with champagne.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

dish.n: El Paraiso dark rum pineapple punch

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon for 3 minutes, then cool.
In a jug, stir the rum, pineapple juice, lime juice, 40ml of the syrup and bitters.
Pour over ice into four tall glasses, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a lime wheel.
Muddle the lemon wedges with the mint leaves and syrup in a shaker.
Add the bourbon and ice and shake.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice.
Slap a big sprig of mint between your hands and set on top.
Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer.
Wet the rims of four glasses with lime and dip them in the salt.
Juice the blood oranges and limes.
Shake the mezcal, juices and agave hard over ice for 15 seconds, in two batches if needed.
Strain over fresh ice and garnish each glass with an orange wheel.

dish.n: Heatwave lager with lime and chilli salt
dish.make_ahead: Rim the glasses up to 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Mix the salt, chilli powder and lime zest on a plate. Run a lime wedge around the rims of 4 chilled glasses and dip in the chilli salt.
Squeeze lime juice into each glass, add ice, then pour in the cold lager slowly.

dish.make_ahead: Mix the base up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Juice the lemons and stir the sugar into the juice with a little warm water.
Shake the whiskey with the lemon mix and ice, then strain into 4 ice-filled jam jars. Top up with lemonade and lemon for anyone not drinking.
Chill the cans of lager until icy and the pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour the lager into the frosted glasses.
Pour the bourbon into shot glasses.
Drink the shot and chase it with the beer, or drop the shot glass carefully into the beer.
Serve with a bowl of salted peanuts.
Ginger beer and a squeeze of lime for anyone not drinking.
Blitz the continental cucumber with the water and strain.
Rim the glasses with lime and salt.
For each drink, muddle the slices of jalapeño in a shaker, add the tequila, the cucumber juice, the lime juice and the agave, shake with ice and strain over fresh ice.
Garnish with a cucumber ribbon.
For non-drinkers, top the cucumber, lime and agave with soda instead.

dish.n: Rita's sweet vermouth on the rocks

steps.text: Put a large ice block in each rocks glass
Pour over the vermouth and add a dash of bitters
Peel long strips of orange zest, twist over the glass, rub round the rim and drop in. Stir twice

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 (2011)

dish.n: Lamb and stout stew over mash
dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the onions and carrots.
Brown the lamb in batches.
Add the onions, carrots, stout and water.
Simmer until tender.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
Serve over the mash with crusty bread on the side.

dish.n: Greater good steak and ale pie

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches and soften the sliced onions.
Add thyme, ale and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and braise gently until the beef is tender.
Thicken the sauce with the flour mixed to a paste, simmer, then tip into a pie dish and cool slightly.
Top with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Cut the potatoes into chips, fry until golden, and boil the peas. Serve alongside.

film: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)

steps.text: Warm half the pomegranate juice with the sugar, cinnamon and cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool.
Pour into a jug with the wine, the rest of the juice, orange slices and brandy.
Chill for at least 2 hours.
Pour over ice into cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top.

dish.make_ahead: Make the rum-free jug the same way for the younger crew

ingredients.item: soda water, for the rum-free jug

steps.text: Stir the rum, juices and grenadine in a large jug.
Chill for an hour.
Fill tall glasses with ice, pour in the punch and finish with grated nutmeg, a pineapple wedge and a cherry.
For the younger crew, make a second jug without the rum and top it with soda water.

dish.n: Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream

steps.text: Brew the strong coffee.
Whip the cream with the maple syrup to soft peaks.
Into each of the big mugs pour the maple syrup and the bourbon, then the hot coffee and stir.
Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg.
Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers.
Make sure everyone gets the right mug.
Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.
Fill glasses with ice, add the gin, some lychee syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.
Top with ginger ale and stir once.
Thread a lychee onto a cocktail pick with a thin slice of ginger and lay it across each glass.
Chill four coupes.
Stir the rye, vermouth and bitters over plenty of ice, one or two at a time.
Strain into the coupes and drop in a cherry.

ingredients.item: limes, juiced, with some cut into wedges

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub a lime wedge around each of 4 glass rims and dip in the chilli salt.
Add ice a good squeeze of lime juice, the tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, dividing evenly.
Top each with a cold lager, stir gently and slip the glasses into small paper bags.
Mix the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, lime juice and rum in a big jug or bowl.
Chill.
Just before serving, add the lemonade, orange slices and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint.

film: Once Upon a Time in America (1984)

dish.n: Fat Moe's rye whiskey sour in teacups
dish.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool to make syrup.
Shake the whiskey, lemon juice, 40ml of the syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into four china teacups, dot the foam with bitters and serve straight away.
Rub a lime wedge around the rims of tall glasses and dip in sea salt.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Add tequila, grapefruit juice and lime juice to each glass.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.
Muddle some cucumber slices with the mint, juice of two limes and sugar syrup in a jug. Add the gin and stir.
Fill wine glasses with ice and the remaining cucumber.
Strain the gin mix into the glasses and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.
Muddle the mint leaves and lemon wedges with the syrup in a shaker.
Add the bourbon and ice and shake hard.
Double strain into 4 glasses filled with crushed ice.
Top with a sprig of mint and serve with short straws.

dish.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whip the cream to soft ribbons so it just holds its shape. Brew the coffee.
Warm 4 heatproof glasses with hot water and tip it out.
Add brown sugar, whiskey and coffee to each glass and stir until dissolved.
Float the cream on top over the back of a spoon. Do not stir.
Fill four glasses with ice.
Add rum, pineapple juice, orange juice, lime juice and grenadine to each.
Stir and finish with a light grating of nutmeg.
Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in 140C oil until cooked but pale, drain and cool.
While the frites cool, season the steaks.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Sear the steaks in a heavy hot pan with oil on both sides.
Lower the heat, add the butter and thyme and baste briefly, then rest the steaks.
Add the peppercorns to the pan, then the brandy, carefully and away from the flame, and simmer briefly.
Add the stock and reduce, then stir in the cream and simmer. Serve with the steaks and frites.
Steep the tea bags in the water for 5 minutes, then remove.
Stir in the honey and the juice of one lemon.
Add whisky to each mug and pour over the tea. Finish with a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with cloves. Leave out the whisky for a plain version.
Fill large wine glasses with ice.
Pour the aperitif into each, then add the prosecco and soda water. Stir gently once.
Slide a thick wedge of blood orange into each glass and serve with a bowl of olives.
Warm heatproof glasses with hot water, then tip it out.
Stir the sugar and whiskey into each glass, then fill with hot coffee to near the top.
Lightly whip the cream until it just thickens but still pours.
Pour the cream slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.

dish.n: Asgardian honey ginger beer or mead
dish.make_ahead: Alcohol is optional, for the grown-ups

ingredients.item: chilled mead, optional for the grown-ups

steps.text: Stir a spoon of honey and a squeeze of lemon into each of four glasses until dissolved.
Fill with ice and top with ginger beer.
For the grown-ups, pour chilled mead instead. Raise the glasses high.

dish.n: Holy water gin and elderflower fizz

steps.text: Shake the gin, cordial and lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into tall glasses over fresh ice and top with soda water.
Add a mint sprig and a lemon wheel. For non-drinkers, swap the gin for chilled cucumber juice.
Put the herbal liqueur in the freezer.
Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add liqueur and lime juice to each, then top with cold ginger beer.
Stir once, add an orange slice and toast on the roof.

dish.n: Light horse camp beef and stout stew
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the chuck, onions and carrots and toss the beef in flour.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onions, carrots and garlic and cook.
Add the tomato paste, stout, stock, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.
Freeze the martini glasses.
Stir the gin and vermouth over ice in batches, then strain into the glasses.
Garnish each with an olive.
For each drink, measure 60ml bourbon, 10ml demerara sugar syrup and 2 dashes aromatic bitters into a mixing glass.
Stir each drink with ice in a mixing glass for 20 seconds
Strain into a rocks glass over one large ice block
Squeeze a strip of orange peel over the top and drop it in

dish.n: Warm sake with yuzu and ginger

steps.text: Pour the sake into a heatproof jug with the ginger.
Stand the jug in a pan of hot water over low heat until warm to the touch, about 50C, never boiling.
Stir in the yuzu and honey and pour into small cups.
Steep the tea bags for 5 minutes, remove them and stir in the jam.
Chill well, then strain out any fruit.
Mix with lemon juice and vodka.
Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the tea, top with soda water and garnish with a lemon slice and cherries.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in oil.
Add the onions, carrots, stout and water to cover and simmer.
Add the potatoes and simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread.
Dissolve the honey in the hot water.
Shake both rums, lime juice, grapefruit juice and the honey syrup with ice.
Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice.
Add a lime wheel to each and grate a little nutmeg on top.
Stir the bourbon, vermouth and bitters with ice.
Strain into 4 chilled coupes and drop a cherry in each.
Cook the rigatoni 2 minutes short of done.
Saute the garlic and chilli in the butter.
Fry the tomato paste until brick red.
Add the vodka and cook it off, then add the cream.
Toss the pasta through the sauce with the parmesan and basil.
